name: knowledge_template
label: Knowledge Base Template
description: Knowledge base template can be used for enabling status filtering and time dimension statistics in report queries related to the knowledge base.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Primary key ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: lcd
fields.description: Update time. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_lcd
indexes.description: Standard index covering the lcd field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
